headline: South Korea's Central Bank Surveys Major Banks on Crypto Vulnerabilities
summary: The Bank of Korea surveyed its largest banks to assess potential impacts from a major crypto hack, price crash, or losses at other firms, alongside examining crypto teams and budgets.
why: Bank stress testing and systemic risk evaluations help regulators and financial institutions gauge exposure to digital assets and technological disruptions in the banking sector.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: The central bank survey evaluates domestic banking sector exposure to cryptocurrency risks.
